### V27 addendum — the player-termination fixture (P14A.2-T0, 2026-09-18)

Minted ONCE at the **final V27 writer `ef9ff76`** itself (not at `e0676f9`), in a throwaway worktree removed after the run, by a
one-off uncommitted script whose full source and output are recorded in `docs/engineering/playability-launch-review/evidence/p14a2-20260918/00-fixtures.txt`.
Input: the genuine `legacy-v27-natural-rival-labs-20.json.gz` above. The script signs that world's week-20 hiring-market actor for 208
weeks and releases them through the real `releaseTalent` action, so `ef9ff76`'s OWN termination law prices the charge:
`terminationCost` at that commit is `iround(TUNING.HIRING_TERMINATION_FRACTION × guaranteedComp(...))`, the 50% law. No amount, row
or receipt is hand-forged. This is the genuine pre-V28 charge the R4 lift reconciles against, replacing the price-forging technique
`tests/p14a1-save-v28.test.ts` had to use when no such fixture existed.
